items.guidance: Check whether immich-server and immich-machine-learning in docker/docker-compose.prod.yml use different images or build contexts. The selected build file, machine-learning/Dockerfile, starts python -m immich_ml, which is the machine-learning service, not the main server. Report which image is the main web app and whether the server can run without the machine-learning service by configuration.

Check where the server code creates bullmq Workers and whether the same server process starts them, for example through a worker or mode setting, or through worker_threads. Report the file, the process that starts the job runner, and any environment variable that selects which workers run.

Check machine-learning/Dockerfile for build arguments or stages that select a device or acceleration variant, and check whether a CPU variant exists. Report the build argument or setting and its CPU value, if present, and whether the main server image needs a GPU at all.
